title: A small nonlinear coefficient description has full ambient covariance
statement: For independent U~N(0,I_r),V~N(0,I_M), M=binom(r+p-1,p), F_c=M^-1/2 sum c_gamma phi_gamma(U)V_gamma in pure chaos degree p+1 and sigma_c^2=||c||^2/M, reading r U coordinates then one V direction gives exact all-read-noise risk(1-alpha^(p+1))sigma_c^2, alpha=1/(1+s). EVERY fixed q unit-power linear design on JOINT(U,V), allowing mixing/repeats/oblique rows/random fixed designs/arbitrary nonlinear predictor, has risk>=max(0,sigma_c^2-(p+1)||c||inf^2 alpha q/M). Gaussian chaos conditioning/common tensor contraction and tr posterior-mean covariance<=alpha q supply the bound; no block-respecting projection assumed. Fixed p>=2 and bounded nonvanishing coefficients yield Omega(M) fixed reads versus r+1 feedback reads at constant accuracy, not an exact fixed optimum. p=2,r=128,M=8256,s=.01 balanced theorem: finite context/pattern/ADC MSE<=.0299713103 with129 reads, EVERY fixed129 risk>=.9535891089. MSE<=.03 requires AT LEAST 2,697 fixed reads, not sufficiency; noisy observation of all 8,384 coordinates once gives separate sufficient ideal risk. Unit-pattern ideal two-round/full-coordinate risk .0294098521 is distinct from finite-pattern bound.

requires: Known degree p normalized Hermite layout and coefficient vector c; independent U~N(0,I_r),V~N(0,I_M),M=binom(r+p-1,p),target variance||c||^2/M.

Two-round protocol observes U then a normalized V aggregate; all read noises independent iid N(0,s). Fixed comparator may use arbitrary unit-power JOINT(U,V) rows,repeats,obliqueness,independent randomization and any nonlinear decoder.

Polynomial gap uses fixed p>=2 and bounded nonvanishing coefficient family; r128balanced finite-control theorem and r64acquired synthetic instance are distinct. Necessary fixed-read lower bound is not sufficiency/optimum.
